digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and child process runtime scoping
propositions: Write and apply paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of S2 scoped runtimes, enabling credential leakage to unintended scopes or sibling processes
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default, causing requests to target unintended projects when scope is unset

Environment builder must isolate child process overlays: trusted children inherit ambient, owning children receive adapter overlay, unrelated siblings lose other adapters' declared secret names, and Rebar never mutates global os.environ

Current code has four hard-coded DIG defaults: resolve_jira_settings project_default, access_check JIRA_PROJECT fallback, _CLOUD_PROJECT_DEFAULT constant, and _DEFAULT_PROJECT constant that must each fail closed with typed error when scope is absent
Reconciler subprocess boundary must pass tracker/Jira/reconciler selections as non-secret snapshot material while restricting adapter secrets to owning process only
Concurrent operations with different overlays must preserve os.environ byte-equality and prevent cross-operation credential or config observation
